annotations.title: Log or schedule an interview round

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Adds an interview round to a tracked application (type, date and time, format, link, interviewers, preparation notes), or edits one with interview_id: mark it done, passed or failed, reschedule or cancel it. Adding the same type and time twice edits that round instead of duplicating it. Shows on techjobs.vn right away.

application_id.description: Apply Tracker entry id from list_applications or track_job.

clear_fields.description: Fields of the round to remove, by name, e.g. ["scheduled_at"].

duration_min.description: Length in minutes. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

format.description: phone, video, onsite or async. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

interview_id.description: Edit this round (id from list_interviews). Omit to add a new round.

interviewers.description: Names and roles. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

location_or_link.description: Address or meeting link. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

prep_note.description: The user's preparation notes. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

round_no.description: Round number; omit to use the next one.

scheduled_at.description: ISO date and time, e.g. 2026-10-12T09:00+07:00 (include the offset, or pass timezone). Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

timezone.description: IANA zone such as Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

type.description: Kind of round. Required when adding a new round.

name: log_interview
